name: Financial Instrument Identification Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the financial instrument identification type.

BELC.name: Code SRW Secretariaat Voor Roerende Waarden Or SVM Secrétariat Des Valeurs Mobilières
BELC.definition: National securities identification number for BE issued by the National Numbering Association SIX Telekurs Belgium.

BLOM.name: Bloomberg
BLOM.definition: Ticker-like code assigned by Bloomberg to identify financial instruments.

CCCD.name: Other National Securities Identification Number
CCCD.definition: National Securities Identification Number issued by the National Numbering Association for a country for which no specific financial instrument identification type code already yet. The first two letters of the code represents the country code (for example, EGDC for Egyptian NSIN). To be used only until the code is added to the ISO ExternalFinancialInstrumentIdentificationType1Code list.

CMED.name: Chicago Mercantile Exchange CME
CMED.definition: Ticker-like code assigned by the Chicago Mercantile Exchange to identify listed-derivatives instruments.

COMM.name: Common Code
COMM.definition: National securities identification number for ICSDs issued by the National Numbering Association Clearstream and Euroclear.

CTAC.name: Consolidated Tape Association CTA
CTAC.definition: Ticker-like code assigned by the Consolidated Tape Association to identify financial instruments.

CUSP.name: Committee On Uniform Security Identification Procedures CUSIP
CUSP.definition: National securities identification number for US and CA issued by the National Numbering Association Standard & Poor´s - CUSIP Global Services.

FIGC.name: Financial Instrument Global Identifier Composite
FIGC.definition: A Financial Instrument Global Identifier Composite (FIGC) is a unique, persistent twelve character string that serves to identify financial instruments across asset classes at the composite level, is associated with one or more FIGI venue level ID’s and a single Share Class level ID.

FIGG.name: Financial Instrument Global Identifier Share Class
FIGG.definition: A Financial Instrument Global Identifier Share Class (FIGG) is a unique, persistent twelve character string that serves to identify financial instruments across asset classes at the global share class level, and is associated with one or more Composite level ID’s.

FIGI.name: Financial Instrument Global Identifier
FIGI.definition: A Financial Instrument Global Identifier (FIGI) is a unique, persistent twelve character string that serves to identify financial instruments across asset classes at the venue level. It is associated with one Composite ID.

ISDU.name: ISDA And Fp ML Product URL In Security ID
ISDU.definition: URL in Description to identify OTC derivatives instruments.

ISDX.name: ISDA And Fp ML Product Specification XML In Encoded Security Desc
ISDX.definition: XML in Description to identify OTC derivatives instruments.

LCHD.name: LCH Clearnet
LCHD.definition: Ticker-like code assigned by LCH to identify listed-derivatives instruments.

OCCS.name: Options Clearing Corp OCC
OCCS.definition: Ticker-like code assigned by the Options Clearing Corporation to identify financial instruments.

OPRA.name: Options Price Reporting Authority OPRA
OPRA.definition: Ticker-like code assigned by the Options Price Reporting Authority to identify financial instruments.

RCMD.name: Markit Red Code
RCMD.definition: Ticker-like code assigned by Markit to identify listed-derivatives instruments.

RICC.name: Reuters Instrument Code RIC
RICC.definition: Ticker-like code assigned by Thomson Reuters to identify financial instruments.

SEDL.name: Stock Exchange Daily Official List SEDOL
SEDL.definition: National securities identification number for GB issued by the National Numbering Association London Stock Exchange.

SICC.name: Securities Identification Code Committee
SICC.definition: National securities identification number for JP issued by the National Numbering Association 6 Stock Exchanges and JASDEC (Securities Identification Ticker-like code Committee).

TIKR.name: Ticker Symbol TS
TIKR.definition: Ticker Code assigned by an exchange to identify financial instruments.

VALO.name: VALOR
VALO.definition: National securities identification number for CH and LI issued by the National Numbering Association SIX Telekurs Ltd.

WKNR.name: Wertpapierkennummer WKN
WKNR.definition: National securities identification number for DE issued by the National Numbering Association WM Datenservice.

CCDC.name: Bond Identification Code List China
CCDC.definition: National Bond identification number for China issued by CHINA CENTRAL DEPOSITORY & CLEARING CO., Limited.

DTID.name: Digital Token Identifier
DTID.definition: Digital Token Identifier, as defined in ISO 24165.
